data.description: When running PowerUpsCombat Gym scene, hitting exit and returning causes crash: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'add') at Scout.tryFireAimedBullet (Scout.ts:309). Likely scene lifecycle issue - collection not re-initialized on scene restart.
data.title: Fix Scout.tryFireAimedBullet crash on scene re-entry

data.author: @agent
data.comment:
Audit gap: The work item description does not include a commit hash or feature branch reference. The merge gate could not auto-resolve the integration state. The fix is committed as d2c1c456c724303375ae8b87e1ba20742646fd15 — please update the description to include this commit reference for future audit runs.

Audit gap: No acceptance criteria are defined on this work item, so the audit could not verify the fix against specific criteria. Please add ACs to enable proper audit verification.

Test failures: npm test has 6 failures in GymFormationScene.test.ts (AH-0MTV7JOLU006W8PT) — these are pre-existing and unrelated to the Scout.ts fix. Commit d2c1c45 does not modify GymFormationScene.test.ts.

Code verification: The fix correctly adds a null-scene guard (if (!this.scene) return null) to tryFireAimedBullet(), mirroring the existing guard in playExplosion(). The guard prevents the TypeError crash on scene re-entry.
